newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to seek to privatise all state companies.
newsitem.headline: Israel to seek to privatise all state companies.

text.p: Israel's privatisation chief said on Monday that it was very important the government completely divest itself of shares in state-owned companies.

"If the results will be that we will still hold shares in our hands then I haven't done my job," Tzippi Livni, who heads the government Corporations Authority, said at the Jerusalem Business Conference.
She said protecting national security interests could be done by retaining a golden share and through deregulation.
Livni said her priority would be to offer shares whenever possible on the bourse.
"If there's a company whose shares I can offer and the market can determine who will hold the controlling stake, that is preferable," she said.
Workers opposed to the privatisation programme will have to understand that if these companies are not privatised there is no way they can be revived, she said.
The government has said it plans to present its privatisation programme later in November or in December.
